public_family_candidate: canary/progressive delivery with bounded staged validation, explicit promotion gate, and rollback without deleting prior history

fatal_gates.F1: current assignment remains authoritative until a distinct promoted-target terminal identity is read back; preparation/shadow evidence alone cannot create authority or credit
fatal_gates.F2: no richer-mode/manual-user/protected-primary/external hosted rollout controller, finite quota, or incremental monetary cost

guards: G1 a switch instance records source A, candidate B, scope key, ordered validation stages, and promotion criteria before any B evaluation
G2 B shadow/canary observations must be unique independently read-back same-scope terminal identities; transport failures, duplicates, stale replays, and scope mismatches do not satisfy a stage
G3 A remains authoritative throughout all nonterminal B validation stages and continues to own current credit
G4 promotion requires every precommitted stage gate to pass; no single favorable observation can skip remaining stages
G5 a failed stage marks the switch instance ROLLBACK/REJECTED and preserves all prior A/B evidence as immutable history while B remains non-authoritative
G6 rollback is qualification-only in this Chat reduction: no destructive undo or mutation of already-read-back evidence
G7 after ROLLBACK/REJECTED, a late stale promotion completion for that switch instance is rejected and cannot transfer authority
G8 after PROMOTED terminal readback, duplicate promotion replay cannot add a second switch or credit
G9 transport/CAS/readback failure is non-semantic; resume from the last durable stage state and never infer a pass from an attempted write
G10 bounded exact-scope exit with nonempty frontier and zero residual richer-mode/user execution, zero finite quota, zero incremental monetary cost

stage_gates.criterion: B same-scope terminal utility >= A baseline + 0.5
second distinct B terminal utility >= A baseline + 0.5
third distinct B terminal utility >= A baseline + 0.5 and no guard violation

success_branch.required: A authoritative through C1/C2/C3; after all three durable passes append CAN-4:PROMOTED; only its terminal readback transfers authority to B; duplicate promotion no-op

candidate_patterns.pattern: immediately switch authority to B after the first favorable observation
evaluate all stages but let attempted/non-read-back writes or duplicate observations satisfy gates
durable staged canary validation with A authoritative until all gates pass; promotion terminal readback transfers authority; failure preserves history and rejects stale promotion
delegate rollout, metric collection, and promotion to an external hosted deployment controller

score_rule: Fatal F1/F2 failure => 0. Otherwise one point per G1-G10 PASS. Do not change trace, gates, controls, guards, or candidate patterns after public source read.
credit_rule: Precommit and canary stages earn zero credit. At most one new leaf credit only after a source-qualified Chat-native reduction passes both success/failure branches and immutable terminal evidence is independently read back.
exact_next_action: Read this precommit back and checkpoint it as pending with zero credit. On the next continuation, before any other family selection, audit public canary/progressive-delivery sources, bind only source-supported staged-promotion/rollback semantics, execute CN-A..CN-D against the fixed trace, and seal/read back terminal evidence before credit.
